items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, gated-product exposure, rights-dependent monetization, affiliate expansion, advertising, and alert expansion. Conditional only for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Exact decision: keep private launch gates unchanged, keep external outreach unsent, retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked, and continue only existing bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: source rights are not established; compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown; security and operations sweeps have no results; revenue is limited to one aggregate unattributed period; accuracy, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required for upstream rights and jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed and 4 remain open. No task is closable on current evidence. Open tasks: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, enable tracking, expand alerts, change the private gate, or expand monetization.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked; user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. No item is clear or conditionally launchable on current evidence.

Private-site decision: retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked. Their scaffold or parked state, missing analytics, and failed or unreachable compliance evidence do not support public launch or monetization. Analytics gaps alone do not block ordinary growth on otherwise evidenced live sites, but these private/gated sites require a concrete site-specific checklist before exposure.
